laws.rule: Tatra National Park: everyone entering must buy a ticket (at entry points, online or by QR code): zł 11 (concession zł 5.50), 7-day zł 55. Children under 7 and residents of the bordering gminas are free. Dolina Chochołowska is charged separately by a landowners' association, often cash only. (No RBA rate for PLN; at the Narodowy Bank Polski rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = about 2.7598 PLN: zł 11 ≈ A$3.99; zł 5.50 ≈ A$1.99; zł 55 ≈ A$19.93)
laws.heading: Tatra National Park

laws.rule: From 1 September 2026, Kraków's night ban on selling alcohol for drinking away from the place of sale (shops, supermarkets, petrol stations, liquor stores) covers all districts of the city, from 10 pm to 6 am. It is set by a city council resolution amending the one of 17 May 2023. The city says breaking it is an offence under Poland's act on sobriety and preventing alcoholism. The notice does not say whether bars and restaurants are covered; the earlier rule excluded them.
